signal: Alkira launched its Connect Partner Program and is being acquired by Lumen Technologies in a deal expected to close Q3 2026

email.body1:
Jason, saw Alkira launched the Connect Partner Program and is heading into the Lumen acquisition, expected to close in Q3.

A new partner motion plus an acquisition usually means more accounts in play than a region can cover before things settle, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount, 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Alkira off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jason, quick follow-up for Alkira.

With a partner program ramping and integration ahead, expectations on pipeline jump faster than regional headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Alkira needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jason, last bit of proof for Alkira.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Alkira's reply rate likely compares to other cloud-networking vendors. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jason, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem. Mid-acquisition is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a regional networking motion? I'll tailor it to Alkira either way.
